title: What 24-Hour Trading Volume Tells You
summary: Twenty-four-hour volume is the total value of an asset traded across markets in the past day. It is a measure of activity and interest, not of price direction.
blocks: Twenty-four-hour volume is the total value of an asset traded across markets in the past day. It is a measure of activity and interest, not of price direction.
High volume means it is easier to enter or exit a position near the quoted price. Very low volume can mean a quoted price is fragile — a single large trade can move it sharply.
Volume is most useful read alongside price: a big move on heavy volume reflects broad participation, while a big move on thin volume can be the work of very few trades.
